text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Unbelievable. How is salad completely 
sold out? *Sigh*... My plans for an 
exquisite lunch are ruined.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, hmm... This is definitely crucial 
information. 'King-san's lunch is ruined 
by the lack of salad'... noted.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
However, giving up here is not the 
first-rate way... *sigh*. I shall 
substitute the vitamins with flavored 
nuts――

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Flavored nuts!? Wh-What an... extremely 
fashionable thing to eat...?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Actually, let's skip the nuts. There 
might be something even more efficient.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Kawakami-san over there has been 
sneaking around right next to me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Notice you? You're impossible not to 
notice! Just what are you doing? Thanks to 
you, I can't concentrate on my thoughts at 
all――

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I mean you! I heard that your 
dietary standards are truly first-rate!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As a princess myself, I wish to dine 
elegantly just like you... So, please... 
give me your guidance...!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you came here because you 
aspire to become a beautiful, graceful, 
and first-rate horse girl just like me?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Just say so from the beginning! Good 
grief, you leave me no choice♪ I 
personally shall guide your dining habits!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Kawakami-san! Prepare your 
notepad! If you aim to be first-rate, you 
must not waste a single second!

In a complete reversal from moments 
before, King Halo and company set about 
picking their menu in high spirits.
